scheme_name: Scheme for Providing Employment Opportunities by Establishing Piggery, Sheep and Goat Units (General)
other_conditions: Applicant must be unemployed (employment in any sector disqualifies)
Applicant must be a resident of Haryana
Applicant must have a space or shed for keeping animals
Applicant must not have previously availed benefits under any Departmental Scheme for establishing a livestock unit
Applicant must submit a self‑declaration confirming unemployment and compliance with scheme conditions
benefits_summary: Eligible applicants receive a subsidy of up to ₹25,000 for a 10+1 piggery unit and up to ₹24,500 for a 15+1 sheep/goat unit (25 % of livestock cost) after verification.
